messages.content: Before I authorize the Atlanta trip, I want to settle the flight timing. The reception is Wednesday evening, and I cannot miss the Saturday roundtable.

The conference schedule shows the opening reception at 5:30 p.m. Wednesday and the roundtable ending at 2:30 p.m. Saturday. The two Wednesday nonstops are 8:05 a.m.-1:00 p.m. and 11:20 a.m.-4:15 p.m. The Saturday returns depart at 5:25 p.m. and 8:10 p.m.
How much usable time does the later Wednesday flight leave once I get into Atlanta?

Very little. A 4:15 p.m. arrival leaves 75 minutes before the reception. Even with MARTA, you would still need to deplane, reach the station, ride downtown, check in, and get to the reception. A modest delay could make you late.
Then keep the 8:05 Wednesday flight. I would rather have time to check in and deal with registration calmly.
That flight arrives at 1:00 p.m. Allowing roughly an hour to deplane and travel downtown should put you at the Hyatt Regency around 2:00 p.m., leaving more than three hours before the reception.
Now compare the Saturday choices against the end of the roundtable. I do not want to slip out early.

For the 5:25 p.m. departure, you could stay through the 2:30 p.m. finish but would need to collect your bag and leave the hotel promptly, ideally by about 2:50 p.m. The 8:10 p.m. flight removes that pressure but adds 2 hours 45 minutes before departure.
Is the Hyatt holding luggage after checkout? I will not be carrying it into the roundtable.

The hotel offers luggage storage for registered guests, though that service should be reconfirmed with the property. You could check out Saturday morning, leave the bag with the bell desk, and retrieve it immediately after the roundtable.
In that case, the 5:25 return still works. I can leave as soon as the session finishes, but not before.

Yes. With the session ending at 2:30 p.m., prompt departure should leave about two and a half hours before takeoff. That is workable if the roundtable ends on schedule and your bag is ready for collection.
Please make the hotel dates explicit. I have seen conference bookings accidentally include Saturday night.

The stay is three nights: check in Wednesday, October 14, and check out Saturday, October 17. The reserved nights would be Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday only. There should be no Saturday-night room charge.
Good. Give me the exact flight pair and hotel dates as the final selection. Do not purchase anything in this step.

Final selection for Atlanta: nonstop Denver to Atlanta on Wednesday, October 14, departing at 8:05 a.m. and arriving at 1:00 p.m.; nonstop Atlanta to Denver on Saturday, October 17, departing at 5:25 p.m. and arriving at 6:40 p.m. Hotel: Hyatt Regency Atlanta, check-in Wednesday, October 14, and checkout Saturday, October 17, for three nights with no Saturday-night stay. Nothing has been purchased or held. Before booking, the fare, schedules, baggage terms, cancellation conditions, hotel total, room availability, and Saturday luggage storage still need confirmation.
